unlocks.title: The Bird Who Wood Be King
A Plesioth in the Misty Peaks
Sky Tribe: Rice to the Occasion

daily.desc:
Increased Health recovery from
items, and Antidote Herb and
Bitterbug always work.

Slows down Stamina depletion
when evading, blocking, etc.

Increases damage for all types of
Barrel Bombs, and increases the
power of Blast attacks.

Increases the potency of
abnormal status attacks.
Often decreases damage taken.
Sometimes decreases damage taken.

Decreases the likelihood of
Horn/Flute items breaking.

Decreases the likelihood of
Pickaxes and Bug Nets breaking.

Maximizes the number of times
you can talk to the Veggie Elder.

Increases Combination
success rate by 20%.

Increases Combination
success rate by 10%.

Sometimes increases the number
of times items can be gathered
at Gathering Points.

Increases the power of
Normal shots (Normal S).

Greatly increases Attack when
Health is very low.

Helps your weapon retain
Sharpness when attacks
are deflected.

Decreases Stamina depletion when
fleeing from large monsters.

Increases damage of projectiles
such as Stones, Throwing Knives,
and Boomerangs.

Prevents flinching when
discovered by a monster.

Slows Stamina depletion from
dashing and prevents knockbacks
when transporting an item.

Prevents being knocked back
when transporting an item.

Large monsters encountered on
Quests have an increased chance
of being weaker than normal.

Makes it easier to escape when
pinned down by a large monster.

Prevents you from sleeping
during a Quest, even on the
base camp bed.

Prevents you from getting
knocked on your butt.

Increases the likelihood fish
will bite when fishing.

Grants a quick recovery when
sent flying by a monster.
Speeds up Palico growth.

Increases Attack and Defense
at the start of a Quest for
a limited amount of time.

Greatly extends the
invulnerability period
when getting up.

Extends the invulnerability
period when getting up.

Increases Bowgun damage, but
also increases Deviation.
Strengthens kicks.

Increases damage inflicted
by the Shadowbox gesture.

Decreases Stamina loss
on walls or icicles. Also
withstands some attacks.

Allows you to withstand
some attacks while
on walls or icicles.

Prevents knockbacks from
attacks while carving.

Prevents stumbling when jumping
down from high places.

Grants a temporary Attack
boost when you use the Kick
Back gesture for a while.

Increases Sharpness when you
strike right after an
attack is deflected.

Causes food effects to remain
even after you faint in battle.

Makes it easier to
stun monsters.

Increases Ballista, Crag shot
(Crag S), Gunlance ammo, Cannon,
and Demolisher damage.

Prevents fainting one time
when damage taken exceeds
your remaining Health.

Guarantees Dung Bombs will be
effective, and ensures their
Combinations will succeed.

Halves the effect durations of
Defense Down and Resistance Down,
and speeds Blight recovery.

Prevents damage from
environmental effects.

Guarantees a large monster
will appear when the hunting
environment is unstable.

Displays large monsters on the
Map at the start of a Quest
for a limited amount of time.
Often speeds up sharpening time.
Makes it easier to mount monsters.

Fills gauge faster when attacking a
monster mounted by another player.

Prevents your group from being penal-
ized the first time a member faints.

Draws monsters' attention, increasing
the likelihood of being targeted.

Sometimes increases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.

Sometimes increases the number
of times you can carve.

Causes additional Supply Items
to be delivered immediately.

Increases the amount of zenny
received at the end of a Quest.

Increases the number of
Hunter Rank Points received
for completing a Quest.

Increases the amount of Wycademy
Points earned at the end of a Quest.
